about_the_game:
Welcome to the naughtiest hotel in town.

You’re the Room Service guy. Your job? Clean up after the city’s hottest, most demanding guests ...  gorgeous futanari and ladyboys who always seem to need something. A towel. A bottle of wine. Or just a reason to tease you while you're on your knees scrubbing the floor.

After each visit, you’re rewarded with a private moment: a high-resolution erotic image of your latest guest in all her naughty glory. But there’s a catch, the image is shattered into puzzle pieces. To relive the scene, you’ll need to reconstruct it piece by piece.

The puzzles are simple but satisfying, designed to let you focus on the real prize: fully uncensored artwork full of detail, charm, and lewd personality. Each completed puzzle unlocks a full image, revealing just what kind of mess you were really cleaning up.

Every completed image is added to your personal Album for later viewing.

Just remember: you're not allowed to touch. Not that it helps your imagination...

It contains strong sexual themes, suggestive dialogue, and adult humor throughout. The content is intended for mature audiences only.
